cases.title: Pinned HEAD/tree identity
cases.expected: HEAD/tree from one pinned commit; drift before publish fails SOURCE_DRIFT, old snapshot preserved.

cases.title: NUL and arbitrary read boundaries
cases.expected: One-byte/random/block splits preserve 55 ordinals, exact raw paths, modes/OIDs/sizes and tail beyond 39.

cases.title: Actual tree above 32 MiB
cases.expected: Synthetic real Git tree >32 MiB ls-tree output completes opt-in CLI; final entry captured in inventory; no file-count ceiling.

cases.title: Reversible unsupported paths
cases.expected: NonUTF8, backslash, colon and unsupported long names remain metadata with reversible hex and reason; tab/newline exact.

cases.title: States and metadata compatibility
cases.expected: Symlink/submodule/protected/missing-size/per-blob policy preserves existing outcomes; no source code execution.

cases.title: Malformed or unterminated output
cases.expected: Bad header, bad oid/mode/kind/size, empty record, duplicate path and EOF fragment fail without publish.

cases.title: Nonzero exit after valid records
cases.expected: Valid NUL records followed by nonzero exit never expose partial snapshot.

cases.title: Wall timeout and quiet child
cases.expected: Deadline triggers without new stdout; stop/reap/join, cleanup bounded; old snapshot unchanged.

cases.title: Stderr flood and backpressure
cases.expected: Separate stderr drain avoids deadlock; bounded retained bytes/total budget and full queue cancellation work.

cases.title: Cancellation and restart
cases.expected: Ctrl-C/cancel stops owned process; interrupted stage never resumed; fresh retry starts Git at zero.

cases.title: Disk and stage quota faults
cases.expected: Fail before/during staging/publish: typed reason, all transaction rows absent, previous heads/chunks preserved.

cases.title: Atomic publication and visibility
cases.expected: Second DB connection sees zero or all new rows; crash/duplicate insert rollback; cursor=0 and no repo_heads update.

cases.title: Existing identity and writer race
cases.expected: Valid same snapshot reuses without state reset; corrupt same id blocks; two writers never duplicate/drop ordinal.

cases.title: CLI/operator boundaries
cases.expected: Existing operator profile, alias/namespace/store scope enforced; stage outside source; Git isolation env and argv exact.

cases.title: Legacy and PR002/003 interoperability
cases.expected: Legacy Native cap/timeout unchanged; explicit snapshotId scan processes >20/39; manifest identities/chunks preserved; PR003 actual test pending artifact.

cases.title: Cold/warm resource receipt
cases.expected: 40k/160k measured separately: stdout bytes, tail, RSS parent/child, stage disk, duration/deadline; Windows NOT_RUN until observed.
